## Why

K14's visual vocabulary existed as decisions and tokens, not
components: stat numerals, cards, chips and badges had no single
renderer, only five of 22 empty surfaces carried the typed cause
pattern, the directness lexicon held D1/D6 alone, and the branded
error set stopped at 404/403/410. This row lands the visual layer as
data contracts + components over the landed `<Figure>` (TX-09) —
every shape an already-answered design line, never a re-decision.

## What ships

### The pure contracts (`web/src/lib/`)

- **`badges.ts` — `sig.badge/1`:** the four neutral text-badge kinds
  (`directness` · `access_kind` · `licence` · `mirror`). Every visible
  label resolves from the lexicon (`states.directness` D1–D6,
  `states.access`), the licence carries the upstream SPDX id verbatim,
  and mirror names where bytes are served from (`mirrored` /
  `at_source` / `no_bytes`). An unknown value throws at build
  (SIG-ENG-042); the raw enum rides `data-value`, never prose
  (SIG-UI-143).
- **`cards.ts` — `sig.card/1`:** the six-kind card contract. A
  non-empty card is a doorway (title + resolvable link); a persona
  card carries 3–4 linked steps; an example card names its `Question`
  meta; an `empty` card renders a named `EmptySurface` and nothing
  else. `STATUS_CHIP_KINDS` is the shared status vocabulary.
- **`errors.ts` — `sig.error-page/1`:** the five-part branded error
  contract — typed state, what happened, what exists nearby, the
  action, when it may change — plus the SIG-UI-151 recovery trio
  (search · home · status) as plain GET links.
- **`empty.ts` — typed everywhere:** all 22 surfaces carry the
  five-part pattern with a named `cause` (`EMPTY_CAUSES`:
  not_researched / not_connected / not_published / not_reviewed /
  none_recorded / filtered_none / not_redistributable / degraded).
  Pipeline causes never route the visitor to the research queue
  (F-409/F-410); `NON_ABSENCE_CAUSES` render no hatch — a filter
  returning nothing or a rights hold is not a gap in the record.
- **`lexicon.json`:** the missing §10.5 directness classes D2–D5
  (D1/D6 landed earlier).

### The components (`web/src/components/`)

`Badge`, `StatusChip` (provisional · historical+`since` ·
not reviewed · superseded · withdrawn), `SupportChip` (glyph + label +
evidence count, UA-native popover — no JS), `FieldChips` (four
independent fields, `data-fused="false"`), `StatFigure`/`StatRow`
(grouped numerals inside `<Figure>` regions with named denominators —
SIG-UI-084/148), `Card`, `DataTable` (the `<sig-table>` visual shell:
scroll wrap, sticky header, densities, `scope="col"`, `aria-sort`,
plain-GET sort links), `ErrorState`, and the reworked `EmptyState`
(typed parts, `data-cause`, conditional hatch, `withBase()` actions).

### Error pages + harness

- `/500.html` joins 403/404/410 on the one contract — chrome-light,
  noindex, `data-error-kind`, the recovery trio; Astro emits
  `500.astro` flat like `404.astro`, the asset the `D-P34.13-1` dark
  roll's `error_page` mapping reads.
- `/component-kit/` — the internal `SIG_BUILD_INTERNAL` harness
  mounting every component over fixture data (T1-internal, never
  published); its figures run one `defineFigures` registry.

### Copy + coverage

- `batch-02.md`: 60 appended `CK-*` rows (sha256-pinned, `pending`),
  bound to `data-copy`; the 410 body stays notice N-6 (`data-notice`).
- `COVERAGE_MATRIX.csv`: the five owned ids →
  `MET-ENGINEERED(D-R10-PUBLISH-1)` (achieved `implementation`, owed
  leg the publish home).
